headline: Dream 101, Liberty 98 (OT): Atlanta edges New York to take 2-0 lead
whyCareReason: Atlanta overcame Breanna Stewart's 35-point performance to win an overtime classic 101-98 and take a 2-0 series stranglehold.
teaser: Reese and Canada scored 23 each before Hillmon's clutch bucket iced overtime. Game 3 moves to New York with Liberty facing elimination.
story: The Atlanta Dream captured a 2-0 series lead in the WNBA Semifinals on Wednesday night, holding off the New York Liberty 101-98 in an overtime thriller at Gateway Center Arena. Angel Reese and Jordin Canada powered Atlanta with 23 points apiece, matching Breanna Stewart's brilliant 35-point, 11-rebound display for New York. With the game tied in the extra session, Naz Hillmon converted a go-ahead layup with 20.8 seconds left. After a controversial timeout sequence where New York could not advance the ball, Atlanta sealed the win at the free-throw line. The series now shifts to Barclays Center for Game 3 on Friday 9 October with the defending finalist Liberty facing elimination.
stakes: Atlanta moves within one victory of the WNBA Finals, while New York faces a must-win Game 3 on home court.
rivalryAngle: The fourth-seeded Dream have now won consecutive postseason games against the star-studded Liberty.
